api.notes: Self-serve create-node wizard at myaccount.e2enetworks.com (verified 2026-11-09, Delhi-NCR): an instance type is offered for A100, A30, A40, L4, L40S, T4 and V100; H100 returns 'No Instance Types Available'; B200, H200 and RTX PRO 6000 are on the rate card but absent from the wizard; the Chennai location has no GPU tab. TIR (tir.e2enetworks.com) is a separate AI platform and exposes no stock either. No free/total GPU counts are published anywhere, so availability is not recorded from this source.

reliability.capacity_notes: H200 is on the rate card but the Delhi create-node wizard lists no instance type for it, and Chennai offers no GPU ordering (checked 2026-11-09); plan capacity before committing.
reliability.notes: Official pricing lists B200 (180GB), H200, H100, RTX PRO 6000, A100 80/40GB, A40, L40S, V100, A30, L4 and T4. B200 is sold as 180GB on E2E; NVIDIA hardware is 192GB. Console/API GPU plans return empty while the account is unvalidated.
